Purpose of script: To check the model results and plot it

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
library(ggh4x)
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Define mvn and corresponding mono analyses 
```{r}
# Define mvn analyses  
patmvn_sel <- c("multi_mmr", "multi_mmr-vzv", "multi_dtpw", "multi_dtpa", "multi_hib-men",
                "multi_men", "multi_pertua", "multi_ipv", "multi_strep7", "multi_strep10",
                "multi_strep11", "multi_strep13")

# Read in raw mvn data 
dat_l <- lapply(str_subset(str_subset(str_subset(
  list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), 
  "s08.rds"), "datase", negate = TRUE), paste(patmvn_sel, collapse = "|")), readRDS)
names(dat_l) <- sub(
  ".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v3|v1)_s08.*", "\\1", str_subset(str_subset(str_subset(
    list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}")), "s08.rds"), "datase", negate = TRUE), 
    paste(patmvn_sel, collapse = "|")))

# Identify mvn, imm_name and correponding mono data
patmvn_uvn <- lapply(dat_l, function(x) {
  select(x, starts_with("imm_val_s1_")) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "imm_name") %>%
    distinct(imm_name)
    }) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "pat") %>%
  mutate(imm_name = str_remove_all(imm_name, "imm_val_s1_anti_|_"),
         patuni = case_when(
           pat %in% c("multi_dtpa", "multi_pertua") & imm_name == "pertupt" ~ "pertuapt",
           pat == "multi_dtpw" & imm_name == "pertupt" ~ "pertuwpt",
           pat == "multi_ipv" & imm_name == "polio1" ~ "ipv1",
           pat == "multi_ipv" & imm_name == "polio2" ~ "ipv2",
           pat == "multi_ipv" & imm_name == "polio3" ~ "ipv3",
           pat == "multi_pertua" & imm_name == "pertufha" ~ "pertuafha",
           pat == "multi_pertua" & imm_name == "pertuprn" ~ "pertuaprn", 
           .default = imm_name)) 
```

# Raw data 
```{r}
# Read in the waic (only models that converged)
waic_l <- list()
waic_l$all <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waic.rds"))
# Read in samples
sam_l <- list()
sam_l$all <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_samplescosine.rds"))
# Read in data gaps
all_datagaps <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagaps.rds"))
```

# Check WAIC =======================================================================================

# Prepare data 
```{r}
# Data from mvn models 
waic_l$mvn <- filter(waic_l$all, pat %in% patmvn_sel, dat == "s08", mod_out == "imm") %>%
  mutate(multi = TRUE, patuni = NA, imm_name = NA, patuni_tidy = NA) %>%
  select(mod, waic, pat, patuni, imm_name, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, patuni_tidy, 
         Rhat_cond, multi)
# Data from uvn models 
waic_l$uvn <- filter(waic_l$all, pat %in% patmvn_uvn$patuni, dat == "s08", mod_out == "imm") %>%
  rename(patuni = pat, patuni_tidy = pat_tidy) %>%
  right_join(patmvn_uvn, by = join_by(patuni), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  mutate(multi = FALSE) %>%
  select(mod, waic, pat, patuni, imm_name, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, patuni_tidy, 
         Rhat_cond, multi)
# Bring data together 
waic_l$muvn <- bind_rows(waic_l$mvn, waic_l$uvn) %>%
  arrange(pat, patuni, waic) %>%
  group_by(pat, patuni, mod_out, dat) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1])
```

# Compare the coefficients of the mvn and unv models ===============================================

# Prepare data 
```{r} 
# Data from mvn models 
sam_l$mvn <- filter(sam_l$all, pat %in% patmvn_sel, dat == "s08", mod_out == "imm") %>%
  # From pat and imm_name, add patuni and patuni_tidy
  left_join(patmvn_uvn, by = join_by(pat, imm_name)) %>%
  left_join(rename(tidy_names_pat, patuni = pat, patuni_tidy = pat_tidy), by = join_by(patuni)) %>%
  select(sam_no, pat, patuni, everything())

# Data from uvn models 
sam_l$uvn <- filter(sam_l$all, pat %in% patmvn_uvn$patuni, dat == "s08", mod_out == "imm") %>%
  rename(patuni = pat, patuni_tidy = pat_tidy) %>%
  right_join(select(patmvn_uvn, -imm_name), by = join_by(patuni), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  select(sam_no, pat, patuni, everything())

# Bring data together 
sam_l$muvn <- bind_rows(sam_l$mvn, sam_l$uvn)
```

# Plot it 
```{r}
sampl_l <- list()
sampl_l <- sapply(c("csi_reg_6", "csi_reg_4", "csi_reg_3", "csi_reg_2", "cs"), function(x) {
  # Filter accordingly 
  datpl <- filter(sam_l$muvn, mod_name == x) %>%
    filter(pat %in% unique(filter(sam_l$mvn, multi == TRUE, mod_name == x)$pat)) %>%
    distinct(pat, patuni, pat_tidy, patuni_tidy, imm_name, reg, clu, clu_tidy, multi, 
           sam_amp_mean, sam_amp_ci95lo, sam_amp_ci95up, 
           sam_phi_mean, sam_phi_ci95lo, sam_phi_ci95up) %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("sam_"), names_pattern = "sam_(amp|phi)_(mean|ci95lo|ci95up)",
                 names_to = c("param", "summary")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = summary, values_from = value) %>%
    mutate(ci95lo1 = ci95lo,
           ci95up1 = if_else(param == "phi" & ci95lo >= ci95up, 52, ci95up),
           ci95lo2 = if_else(param == "phi" & ci95lo >= ci95up, 0, NA),
           ci95up2 = if_else(param == "phi" & ci95lo >= ci95up,  ci95up, NA))
  if(x == "csi_reg_6") datpl <- filter(datpl, pat!= "multi_dtpw")
  
  pl_l <- list()
  for(p in c("amp", "phi")) {
    pl_l[[p]] <- filter(datpl, param == p) %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = mean, y = patuni_tidy, color = multi)) + 
      geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 1)) + 
      geom_segment(aes(x = ci95lo1, xend = ci95up1), position = position_dodge(width = 1)) + 
      geom_segment(aes(x = ci95lo2, xend = ci95up2), position = position_dodge(width = 1)) + 
      scale_y_discrete("") + 
      scale_color_manual("MVN", values = c("red", "dodgerblue3")) + 
      facet_nested(pat_tidy+clu_tidy~., 
                   nest_line = TRUE, solo_line = TRUE, scales = "free", space = "free_y")  +
      theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
            legend.position = "top") + 
      ggtitle(x)
    if(p == "amp") {
      pl_l[[p]] <- pl_l[[p]] + 
        scale_x_continuous("Amplitude", trans = "log") + 
        geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey")
    }
    if(p == "phi") {
      pl_l[[p]] <- pl_l[[p]] + 
        scale_x_continuous("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), expand = c(0,0)) 
    }
  }
  # Bring plots together
   return(pl_l$amp + pl_l$phi)
}, simplify = FALSE)

sampl_l$csi_reg_6
```

# Compare the spaguetti plots of the mvn and unv models ============================================

# Prepare data 
```{r} 
datpl_sam <- sam_l$muvn %>%
  filter(sam_no <= 100, checkgaps_all == FALSE) %>%
  crossing(vac_week_v1 = seq(from = 0, to = 2*pi, length = 53)) %>%
  mutate(sam_estimate = exp(p_cos*cos(vac_week_v1) + p_sin*sin(vac_week_v1)),
         mean_estimate = exp(p_cos_mean*cos(vac_week_v1) + p_sin_mean*sin(vac_week_v1)),
         vac_week_v1 = round((52*vac_week_v1)/(2*pi))) %>%
  left_join(distinct(all_datagaps, mod, clu, imm_name, vac_week_v1, tot), 
            by = join_by(mod, clu, imm_name, vac_week_v1))

datpl_sam_rug <- distinct(datpl_sam, mod_name, multi, vac_week_v1, tot, clu_tidy, pat, pat_tidy, patuni_tidy, phi_mean) %>%
  mutate(vac_week_v1 = case_when(!is.na(tot) ~ vac_week_v1)) 
```

# Samples plot 
```{r}
spapl_l <- sapply(c("csi_reg_6", "csi_reg_4", "csi_reg_3", "csi_reg_2", "cs"), function(x) {
  # Identify pathogens per model region 
  pat_reg <- filter(datpl_sam, multi == TRUE, mod_name == x) %>%
    distinct(pat)
  # Plot each of the combinations
  pl_l <- list()
  for(i in pat_reg$pat) {
  pl_l[[i]] <- filter(datpl_sam, mod_name == x, pat == i) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = sam_estimate, group = paste0(sam_no, multi), color = phi_mean)) + 
    geom_line(alpha = 0.1) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_estimate, group = 1), size = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous("Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), expand = c(0,0)) +
    scale_y_continuous("Conditional effect", expand = c(0.2,0)) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      "Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52),
      colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"), rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"))),
      guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5, barheight = 0.8)) +
    geom_point(data = filter(datpl_sam_rug, mod_name == x, pat == i), 
               aes(y = -Inf), group = 1, shape = "|", size = 3) +
    facet_nested_wrap(multi~clu_tidy+pat_tidy+patuni_tidy, 
                      scales = "free_y", nest_line = TRUE, solo_line = TRUE, nrow = 2) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  return(pl_l)
}, simplify = FALSE)

spapl_l$cs$multi_ipv
spapl_l$csi_reg_6$multi_mmr
```

# Obtain correlation matrix ========================================================================

```{r}
df_converged <- filter(waic_l$mvn, dat == "s08", mod_out == "imm") %>%
  # The function needs arguments reg (NA for cs and "reg_x" for csi) and multi (multi pat)
  mutate(reg = case_when(str_detect(mod_name, "csi") ~ str_remove_all(mod_name, "csi_")))
```

# Obtain residual correlation 
```{r}
all_coefrescor <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefrescor.rds"), dir = "", {
  sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
    # Read in the coeficients 
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$coef}/coef_{x}"))$rescor_pars %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "parameter")
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    rename_with(tolower) %>%
    rename(rescor = estimate,
           rescor_se = est.error,
           rescor_ci95lo = 'l-95% ci',
           rescor_ci95up = 'u-95% ci') %>%
    select(mod, parameter, starts_with("rescor")) %>%
    # From mod to variables (pat, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, reg, multi) ----------
    left_join(select(df_converged, -c(patuni, patuni_tidy, imm_name)), by = join_by(mod)) %>%
    # From param to variables (imm_name1, imm_name2, clu) --------------------------------------------
    mutate(parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "rescor|anti|immvals1|\\(|\\)")) %>%
    separate(parameter, into = c("imm_name1", "imm_name2"), sep = ",") %>%
    # From imm_name1 to patuni names and tidy ------------------------------------------------------
    left_join(patmvn_uvn,  by = join_by(pat == pat, imm_name1 == imm_name)) %>%
    rename(patuni1 = patuni) %>%
    left_join(patmvn_uvn,  by = join_by(pat == pat, imm_name2 == imm_name)) %>%
    rename(patuni2 = patuni) %>%
    left_join(rename(tidy_names_pat, patuni1 = pat, patuni_tidy1 = pat_tidy), by = join_by(patuni1)) %>%
    left_join(rename(tidy_names_pat, patuni2 = pat, patuni_tidy2 = pat_tidy), by = join_by(patuni2))
})
```

```{r}
all_coefrescor %>%
  filter(mod_name == "base") %>%
  mutate(multipat = if_else(pat %in% c("multi_ipv", "multi_strep", "multi_men", "multi_pertua"), 
                            "Uni pathogen", "Multi pathogen")) %>%
  filter(pat != "multi_strep") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rescor, y = paste0(patuni_tidy1, "-", patuni_tidy2), color = multipat)) + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey") + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = rescor_ci95lo, xend = rescor_ci95up)) +
  facet_nested(multipat + reorder(pat_tidy, rescor)~., 
               scales = "free", space = "free", nest_line = TRUE, solo_line = TRUE) +
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("orange", "grey")) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
        legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
strep_dat <- all_coefrescor %>%
  filter(mod_name == "base") %>%
  filter(str_detect(pat, "strep")) 

expand_grid(mod = unique(strep_dat$mod),
            patuni1 = unique(c(strep_dat$patuni1, strep_dat$patuni2)),
            patuni2 = unique(c(strep_dat$patuni1, strep_dat$patuni2))) %>%
  left_join(rename(tidy_names_pat, patuni1 = pat, patuni_tidy1 = pat_tidy), by = join_by(patuni1)) %>%
  left_join(rename(tidy_names_pat, patuni2 = pat, patuni_tidy2 = pat_tidy), by = join_by(patuni2)) %>%
  left_join(distinct(strep_dat, mod, patuni1, patuni2, rescor)) %>%
  left_join(distinct(rename(strep_dat, rescor2 = rescor), mod, patuni1, patuni2, rescor2), 
            by = join_by(mod == mod, patuni1 == patuni2, patuni2 == patuni1)) %>%
  left_join(distinct(strep_dat, mod, pat, pat_tidy)) %>%
  mutate(rescor = case_when(#patuni1 == patuni2 ~ 1, 
                            is.na(rescor) ~ rescor2, 
                            .default = rescor)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rescor)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = patuni_tidy1, y = patuni_tidy2, fill = rescor)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_grid(pat_tidy~.) +
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  scale_x_discrete("") + 
  scale_fill_viridis(na.value = "white", direction = -1) + 
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
```
```{r}
expand_grid(mod = unique(strep_dat$mod),
            patuni1 = unique(c(strep_dat$patuni1, strep_dat$patuni2)),
            patuni2 = unique(c(strep_dat$patuni1, strep_dat$patuni2))) %>%
  left_join(rename(tidy_names_pat, patuni1 = pat, patuni_tidy1 = pat_tidy), by = join_by(patuni1)) %>%
  left_join(rename(tidy_names_pat, patuni2 = pat, patuni_tidy2 = pat_tidy), by = join_by(patuni2)) %>%
  left_join(distinct(strep_dat, mod, patuni1, patuni2, rescor, rescor_ci95lo, rescor_ci95up)) %>%
  left_join(distinct(rename(strep_dat, rescor2 = rescor, 
                            rescor_ci95lo2 = rescor_ci95lo,
                            rescor_ci95up2 = rescor_ci95up), mod, patuni1, patuni2, rescor2,
                     rescor_ci95lo2, rescor_ci95up2), 
            by = join_by(mod == mod, patuni1 == patuni2, patuni2 == patuni1)) %>%
  left_join(distinct(strep_dat, mod, pat, pat_tidy)) %>%
  mutate(rescor = case_when(#patuni1 == patuni2 ~ 1, 
                            is.na(rescor) ~ rescor2, 
                            .default = rescor),
         rescor_ci95lo = case_when(#patuni1 == patuni2 ~ 1, 
                            is.na(rescor_ci95lo) ~ rescor_ci95lo2, 
                            .default = rescor_ci95lo),
         rescor_ci95up = case_when(#patuni1 == patuni2 ~ 1, 
                            is.na(rescor_ci95up) ~ rescor_ci95up2, 
                            .default = rescor_ci95up)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rescor)) %>%
  group_by(patuni_tidy1, patuni_tidy2) %>%
  filter(n()>1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(rescor) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rescor, y = paste0(patuni_tidy1, "-", patuni_tidy2), color = pat_tidy)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = rescor_ci95lo, xend = rescor_ci95up)) +
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("lightblue", "darkblue")) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0))
```
